# PRO X Wireless Gaming Headset 046D:0ABA, long-only collection FF43:0202,
# device index 0xFF, over a whole run: arrival with the headset off, switched
# on, off and on twice, 43 min in use (audio playing) without traffic, the PC
# sleeps and resumes, then the headset switched off and on.
#
# Real capture: owner capture 2026-11-23, G HUB closed; one
# process ran both recorded sessions, so the first part equals
# 0aba-headset-arrival.txt. The trace also held the C547 receiver; only this
# group's frames are kept, verbatim (unit id FFFFFFFF is the dongle's
# placeholder). The resume notification is not in the trace: `resume` stands
# where its read was written. The trailing `# +<s>` is the frame's time in the
# capture, counted from app start.
#
# Format: `out <short|long> <hex>` is a frame BatterySight writes, `in` one it
# reads, `@t+<ms>` lets time pass and ticks the hub, `resume` is the system
# resume notification. Each `in` and `resume` advances the clock by 1 ms; `@t+`
# lines restore the capture's gaps over 100 ms. The `out` lines after an input
# are the writes that input causes.
